flags.why: The example applies the insult to women, although this sense refers to a male person, as recorded in [Wiktionary](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/l%E1%BA%B9o_c%C3%A1i).
flags.fix: Ông già trong làng chửi hai chàng trai là đồ lẹo cái. = The old man in the village insulted the two young men by calling them queers.
